issue.title: Min/max length filtering is not working

summary.text: The bug was reproduced, with a test that fails before the fix and passes after it, and no regressions or breaking inputs were found; however, the tests did not catch enough mutants of the fix to guard it, and the behaviour diff was inconclusive. Next, add tests that pin down the default `--min` of 8 and explicitly passed min/max values, so that changes to the fix would be caught.
